players.name: Florence Griffith-Joyner
players.biography: Florence Griffith-Joyner, 'Flo-Jo', is the fastest woman who ever lived. At the 1988 Seoul Olympics she won three gold medals and set world records in both the 100m (10.49 seconds) and 200m (21.34 seconds) that remain unbroken to this day — over 35 years later. Her extraordinary speed, combined with her glamorous image — long nails, elaborate one-legged race suits, and gold jewellery — made her a global sensation. She combined ferocious athletic talent with dazzling personal style. She tragically died of an epileptic seizure at just 38 but her records remain as monuments to her extraordinary talent.
achievements: AP Female Athlete of the Year 1988
fun_facts: Her 100m world record from 1988 has not been broken in over 35 years
She wore elaborate one-legged race suits and long painted nails while running world records
She is the most stylish and glamorous athlete in track and field history
players.style: Explosive starting power, fluid stride, extraordinary top-end speed, unmatched sprint dominance

players.name: Eliud Kipchoge
players.biography: Eliud Kipchoge is the greatest marathon runner in history. The Kenyan holds the world marathon record of 2:01:09 and became the first human being to run a marathon in under two hours (1:59:40 in the INEOS 1:59 Challenge in Vienna in 2019 — not an official world record due to conditions). He has won the Olympic marathon gold twice (2016 Rio, 2020 Tokyo) and won the London Marathon a record six times. His running is described as effortlessly smooth and his philosophy — 'no human is limited' — has inspired athletes worldwide. He trains with a group in Kaptagat, Kenya, and lives simply.
achievements: First sub-2 hour marathon (1:59:40 in Vienna 2019)
fun_facts: He ran a marathon in under 2 hours — 1:59:40 — a historic achievement
His philosophy 'No human is limited' has become a global motto
He trains in a group in Kaptagat and lives a simple, humble life
players.style: Flawlessly efficient running form, extraordinary aerobic capacity, mental tranquility, supreme consistency

players.name: Haile Gebrselassie
players.biography: Haile Gebrselassie is the greatest distance runner in history and the man who defined what was possible in long-distance running for a decade. The Ethiopian set 27 world records from 1500m to the marathon across a 20-year career. He won two consecutive Olympic golds in the 10,000m at Atlanta 1996 and Sydney 2000 with breathtaking performances. He runs with a distinctive left arm held slightly bent — reportedly from running to school as a child holding his textbooks. He broke the marathon world record multiple times and held it with 2:03:59 — the first man to run under 2:04. He is an inspiration across Ethiopia.
achievements: Marathon world record holder (2:03:59 — first sub 2:04)
fun_facts: He set 27 world records across different distances in his career
He runs with one arm bent because he used to hold his school books while running to school
He broke the marathon world record 5 times
players.style: Endurance genius, remarkably consistent pace, devastating finishing kick, mental serenity

players.name: Cathy Freeman
players.biography: Cathy Freeman's 400m gold at the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games is arguably the most emotionally powerful moment in Australian sporting history. The indigenous Australian runner carried the hopes of a nation — and the weight of her people's history — as she ran to victory in front of 112,000 people at the Olympic Stadium. She had lit the Olympic cauldron at the Games' opening ceremony. Her victory — carrying both the Australian and Aboriginal flags on her lap of honour — was a symbol of reconciliation and pride. She won the World Championship in 1997 and 1999 and was Australia's Athlete of the Year multiple times.
achievements: Lit the Sydney Olympics cauldron at opening ceremony
Carried Aboriginal and Australian flags after her victory
fun_facts: She lit the Olympic cauldron at the Sydney 2000 Games opening ceremony
Her 400m gold in front of 112,000 people is Australia's most emotional sporting moment
She carried both the Australian and Aboriginal flags on her victory lap
players.style: Powerful stride, excellent 400m pace judgement, strong in the finishing straight, mentally indestructible

players.name: Lin Dan
players.biography: Lin Dan is the greatest badminton player in the history of the sport, known as 'Super Dan'. He is the only player to have won all nine major badminton titles — the Super Grand Slam — and is the only man to have won consecutive Olympic singles gold medals (2008 and 2012). Born in Longyan, Fujian, China, he joined the Chinese national team at 15 and dominated world badminton for a decade. His rivalry with Malaysian Lee Chong Wei — they met 40 times, each winning on the biggest occasions — is the greatest in the sport's history.
achievements: Super Grand Slam — only player in history
fun_facts: He is the only badminton player to win all 9 major titles (Super Grand Slam)
He came back from two sets down in the 2012 Olympic final against Lee Chong Wei to win
He is nicknamed 'Super Dan' by fans worldwide
players.style: Power smashes, exceptional footwork, physical dominance, incredible endurance, outstanding deception

players.name: PV Sindhu
players.biography: PV Sindhu is the greatest Indian badminton player ever and the first Indian to win an Olympic silver medal in women's singles (Rio 2016) and gold at the World Championships. Born in Hyderabad to volleyball-playing parents, she began badminton at age eight and joined the Pullela Gopichand Badminton Academy at 10. She became a global superstar with her 2016 Olympic silver — at just 21 years old — and added a bronze at Tokyo 2020. Her powerful smashes and deceptive net game have made her one of the most exciting players on the tour.
achievements: Olympic Silver 2016 (Rio) — first Indian woman in badminton
BWF World Championship silver medal 5 times
Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards
fun_facts: She is the first Indian to win a BWF World Championship title
Her parents are both former national-level volleyball players
She trained from 4 AM daily under coach Gopichand for years to reach the elite level
players.style: Powerful smashes, excellent net play, intelligent rally building, strong physical presence

players.name: Tiger Woods
players.biography: Tiger Woods is the most influential golfer in history and, during his peak years from 1997 to 2008, arguably the most dominant athlete in any individual sport on the planet. He first picked up a club at age 2 and appeared on American TV at age 3. He turned professional in 1996 and immediately revolutionised golf's popularity, particularly among young people and minorities. In 1997 he won the Masters by 12 shots — still the record margin. He won 15 major championships in total (including the 2019 Masters at age 43, an extraordinary comeback after back surgery) and 82 PGA Tour titles. He held the world number one ranking for 683 weeks across his career.
achievements: 82 PGA Tour wins — all-time record (tied with Sam Snead)
683 weeks as World No. 1 — all-time record
5× Masters Champion, 3× US Open, 3× The Open, 4× US PGA
PGA Tour Player of the Year 11 times
fun_facts: He appeared on The Mike Douglas Show hitting golf balls aged just 2 years old
He held all four major championships simultaneously in 2000-01 (the 'Tiger Slam')
His 1997 Masters win by 12 strokes is still the largest winning margin in the tournament's history
players.style: Exceptional driving length and accuracy, precise iron play, brilliant short game, unmatched mental focus

players.name: Eddy Merckx
players.biography: Eddy Merckx, nicknamed 'The Cannibal' because he devoured wins so voraciously, is the greatest cyclist who ever lived. He won the Tour de France five times, the Giro d'Italia five times, and the Vuelta a España once. What makes Merckx unique is that unlike most cyclists, who specialise, he won everything: sprints, time trials, mountain stages, classics. In the 1969 Tour de France he won every classification — the overall, the mountain polka dot jersey, and the points jersey — something that has never been done since. He holds the world record for the most professional victories of any cyclist: 525.
achievements: Won all five cycling Monuments multiple times
1969 Tour: won overall, points AND mountain classification simultaneously
fun_facts: He earned the nickname 'The Cannibal' because he kept winning even when the title was already decided — he could not stop himself
He still holds the Hour Record that he set on the high-altitude Velodrome at Mexico City in 1972
He once won a Tour de France stage with a broken collar bone
players.style: All-round excellence, exceptional in mountains and time trials, explosive sprint, relentless attacking style

players.name: Richie McCaw
players.biography: Richie McCaw is universally regarded as the greatest rugby player in history. He captained the All Blacks to two back-to-back Rugby World Cup victories (2011 and 2015) and played 148 Tests for New Zealand — winning 131. He led by extraordinary example: his ability to win the ball at the breakdown was so dominant that referees spent entire World Cups trying to work out how to penalise him, often failing. He won the World Rugby Player of the Year award three times. Under his captaincy, New Zealand had a win rate of over 86% — the highest in the sport's history for a nation that consistently faced the best opponents.
achievements: 3× World Rugby Player of the Year
fun_facts: He played the 2011 World Cup final with a fractured foot — and was named Player of the Tournament
He holds a commercial pilot's licence and flies helicopters in his spare time
His autobiography sold 100,000+ copies in New Zealand — a country of just 5 million
players.style: Masterful breakdown work, exceptional defensive reads, inspirational leadership, accurate kick, physical robustness

players.name: Babe Ruth
players.biography: Babe Ruth is the most iconic figure in baseball history and one of the most recognisable athletes who ever lived. Known as 'The Sultan of Swat', he started his career as a dominant left-handed pitcher before being converted to an outfielder because his batting was too valuable. He hit 714 career home runs — a record that stood for nearly 40 years — with a slugging percentage of .690 that remains the all-time record. He transformed the game: before Ruth, home runs were rare; after Ruth, teams built their offences around the power hitting he had demonstrated was possible. His 60 home runs in the 1927 season stood as the single-season record for 34 years.
fun_facts: He was an elite pitcher before being converted to an outfielder
He hit a home run in his very last at-bat at the original Yankee Stadium
He reportedly consumed 12 hot dogs between games of a doubleheader
players.style: Unprecedented power hitting, deceptive pitching, charismatic personality, natural showman

players.name: Dhyan Chand
players.biography: Major Dhyan Chand is the greatest field hockey player in history, earning the nickname 'The Wizard' for his extraordinary stick control. Born in Allahabad, India, he led India to three consecutive Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936. At the 1936 Berlin Olympics he scored twice in the final as India beat Germany 8–1. Adolf Hitler reportedly offered him a position in the German army — Dhyan Chand politely refused. He scored over 400 goals in international hockey. India celebrates National Sports Day on his birthday, 29 August, honouring his immense contribution to Indian sport.
fun_facts: Hitler offered him a role in the German army after watching him play
India celebrates National Sports Day on his birthday
His statue in Austria shows him with four hands holding four hockey sticks
players.style: Magical stick control, unstoppable dribbling, clinical finishing, inspirational leadership

players.name: Luciana Aymar
players.biography: Luciana Aymar is widely considered the greatest female field hockey player of all time. Nicknamed 'La Maga' (The Magician), the Argentine midfield genius won eight World Player of the Year awards — a record. She led Argentina's Las Leonas to back-to-back Olympic silver medals (2000, 2004), a bronze (2008), and two World Cup titles (2002, 2010). Her dribbling, vision, and creative genius electrified matches. She retired in 2014 having inspired an entire generation of female athletes in Argentina and around the world.
achievements: 8x FIH World Player of the Year
fun_facts: She won 8 World Player of the Year awards — more than anyone in hockey history
She is the most capped player in Argentina women's hockey history
She was once compared to Maradona for her magical dribbling
players.style: Sublime dribbling, creative genius, precise passing, match-winning instinct

players.name: Jamie Dwyer
players.biography: Jamie Dwyer is Australia's greatest field hockey player and one of the finest the game has ever produced. The Queensland native was a relentless attacker with a thunderous drag-flick and brilliant vision. He won five FIH World Player of the Year awards, an Olympic gold medal at Athens 2004, and back-to-back World Cup titles in 2010 and 2014 with the Kookaburras. His goals, leadership, and intensity made Australia the world's dominant hockey nation for over a decade. He retired as one of the highest-scoring players in international hockey.
achievements: 5x FIH World Player of the Year
fun_facts: He won the World Player of the Year five times — a men's record at the time
He represented Australia for 17 years
His drag-flick was one of the most feared in world hockey
players.style: Powerful drag-flick, intelligent movement, tactical awareness, relentless attacking energy

players.name: Sohail Abbas
players.biography: Sohail Abbas is the highest goal scorer in international field hockey history with an incredible 348 goals — a record that may stand forever. The Pakistani drag-flick specialist was a nightmare for goalkeepers around the world, converting penalty corners with frightening accuracy and power. Playing for Pakistan between 1998 and 2010, he was the heart of the team's attack and a two-time Champions Trophy winner. He was named in the All-Star team at multiple World Cups and is remembered as one of the greatest goal-scoring technicians hockey has ever seen.
fun_facts: His 348 goals is the highest ever tally in international field hockey
He was almost impossible to stop at penalty corners
He played over 300 international matches for Pakistan
players.style: Thunderous drag-flick, pinpoint accuracy at penalty corners, cool-headed under pressure

players.name: Ellen Hoog
players.biography: Ellen Hoog was a sparkling attacking forward who helped make the Netherlands women's hockey team the greatest in the world. The Amsterdam-born striker was electric in one-on-one situations and had a sharp eye for goal. She was part of the Dutch team that won the Olympic gold in 2008 and 2012, the World Cup in 2006 and 2014, and multiple European Championship titles. Her pace, skill, and intelligent runs caused defences enormous trouble. Hoog retired in 2016 as one of the most decorated Dutch sportswomen ever.
fun_facts: She won back-to-back Olympic golds with the Netherlands
She was famous for her lightning pace on the right wing
She also modelled and appeared in ESPN Body Issue
players.style: Electric pace, clever movement, sharp finishing, outstanding dribbling under pressure

players.name: Ronnie O'Sullivan
players.biography: Ronnie O'Sullivan, nicknamed 'The Rocket', is the most naturally gifted snooker player ever to pick up a cue. The Essex-born prodigy turned professional at 16 and made the fastest maximum break in history — 147 in 5 minutes 20 seconds — at the 1997 World Championship. He has won a record seven World Championship titles and is known for his ability to play equally brilliantly with both hands. His combination of raw talent, attacking flair, and jaw-dropping potting ability put him in a category of his own. Away from the table he has spoken openly about mental health, inspiring many young people.
fun_facts: He made the fastest ever maximum 147 break — 5 minutes 20 seconds
He can play equally well with both hands
He once ran a half-marathon the morning of a World Championship match
players.style: Lightning-fast potting, both-handed play, explosive breaks, instinctive genius

players.name: Stephen Hendry
players.biography: Stephen Hendry dominated snooker throughout the 1990s like no player before or since. The Scotsman became the youngest World Snooker Champion in 1990 at just 21 years old and went on to win the title an unprecedented seven times. He was ranked world number one for a record 8 consecutive years and accumulated 36 ranking titles — a record that stood for many years. His ice-cool temperament under pressure, combined with his ability to make long pots look routine, made him virtually unbeatable in his prime. He remains the benchmark against which all future snooker champions are measured.
fun_facts: He was world number one for 8 years in a row
He won 7 world titles — matched only by Ronnie O'Sullivan decades later
His rivalry with Jimmy White produced some of the greatest finals in snooker history
players.style: Ice-cold under pressure, precise long-potting, clinical break-building, supreme consistency

players.name: Mark Selby
players.biography: Mark Selby, dubbed the 'Jester from Leicester', is one of snooker's most tenacious and tactically brilliant players. Though not as flashy as some rivals, his defensive mastery, safety play, and ability to win long gruelling matches have brought him four World Championship titles. He is particularly brilliant in the deciding frame, earning him a reputation as one of sport's great pressure performers. His 2016, 2017, and 2021 world titles showed he could win in different eras against different generations. Selby's sheer mental toughness makes him one of the toughest opponents any snooker player can face.
fun_facts: His nickname 'The Jester from Leicester' belies his incredibly tough competitive nature
He is considered the best safety player in modern snooker
He won three World titles in two years (2016, 2017)
players.style: Master tactician, brilliant safety play, incredible mental toughness, decisive-frame specialist

players.name: Ding Junhui
players.biography: Ding Junhui is the player who brought snooker to China, inspiring millions of youngsters to pick up a cue. The gentle giant from Yixing became the first Asian player to win a ranking event when he beat Ronnie O'Sullivan in the 2005 UK Championship final — aged just 18. He has gone on to win multiple ranking events and reached the World Championship final in 2016. His silky smooth stroke-play and century-making ability made him one of the sport's biggest stars. He has done more than anyone to make snooker one of the most watched sports in China.
fun_facts: He beat Ronnie O'Sullivan at 18 to win the UK Championship
He has inspired millions of Chinese children to play snooker
His popularity in China rivals that of footballers
players.style: Fluent stroke-play, consistent century-making, elegant technique, mental calm

players.name: Judd Trump
players.biography: Judd Trump is the most exciting snooker player of his generation — a natural entertainer who plays the game at breathtaking speed. The Bristol potter burst onto the scene as a teenager and reached the World Championship final in 2011 at just 21. He went on to win his maiden world title in 2019, dispatching John Higgins in a dominant display. His potting ability on the longest balls is astounding, and his rapid-fire break-building draws gasps from audiences worldwide. He has won more ranking events than any other player in the modern era and remains snooker's biggest box-office attraction.
fun_facts: He holds the record for most ranking event wins in snooker history
He is known for potting almost impossible long balls
Crowds love his attacking, risk-taking style
players.style: Fearless long-potting, high-speed breaks, attacking flair, dazzling shot selection

players.name: Magnus Carlsen
players.biography: Magnus Carlsen is the greatest chess player in history by peak rating. The Norwegian prodigy became a grandmaster at just 13 years old and went on to achieve the highest FIDE rating ever recorded — 2882 in 2014. He won the World Chess Championship in 2013, defeating Viswanathan Anand, and successfully defended the title five times. What makes Carlsen extraordinary is his ability to grind out wins from seemingly equal positions, his encyclopaedic endgame knowledge, and his deep intuition. He has dominated all formats of chess — classical, rapid, and blitz — simultaneously, something no player in history has ever managed.
fun_facts: He holds the record for the highest chess rating in history
He has dominated classical, rapid, and blitz chess at the same time
He memorised all 8 World Champions' complete game collections as a child
players.style: Universal genius, endgame mastery, relentless pressure, unbeatable from equal positions

players.name: Garry Kasparov
players.biography: Garry Kasparov is considered the greatest chess player of the 20th century. The Azerbaijani-born Soviet prodigy became the youngest World Chess Champion in 1985 at age 22, defeating the legendary Anatoly Karpov. He held the world title for 15 years — longer than anyone else. Kasparov's attacking style, enormous opening preparation, and ferocious competitive spirit made him unstoppable. His matches against IBM's Deep Blue supercomputer in 1996 and 1997 captivated the world. Though the computer won the rematch, Kasparov's game 2 victory in 1996 remains one of chess's most celebrated moments. After retiring he became a prominent political activist.
achievements: Defeated Deep Blue in historic 1996 game
fun_facts: He was world number one for over 20 years
His match against IBM's Deep Blue computer was a global TV sensation
He has an IQ estimated at around 190
players.style: Ferocious attack, brilliant opening preparation, intimidating presence, relentless ambition

players.name: Bobby Fischer
players.biography: Bobby Fischer was a chess prodigy who became an American legend. He became the youngest US Chess Champion at just 14 years old and his rise through the world rankings was phenomenal. His 1972 World Chess Championship match against Boris Spassky in Reykjavik, Iceland — played at the height of the Cold War — was dubbed 'The Match of the Century' and captivated the entire world. Fischer won convincingly, ending decades of Soviet chess dominance. He played with an attacking clarity and perfection that stunned even grandmasters. Though his later life was troubled, his chess genius remains unquestioned.
achievements: 'Match of the Century' winner vs Spassky
fun_facts: He ended the Soviet Union's 24-year grip on the World Chess Championship
His 1972 match against Spassky was watched by millions worldwide
He won 20 consecutive matches without a draw or loss in 1971
players.style: Crystal-clear logic, devastating attack, perfect endgame technique, total chess mastery

players.name: Viswanathan Anand
players.biography: Viswanathan Anand, affectionately known as 'Vishy' or 'Tiger of Madras', is India's first and greatest chess grandmaster. Born in Chennai, he became India's first grandmaster in 1988 and went on to become World Chess Champion five times. His lightning-fast thought and extraordinary speed in calculation earned him the nickname 'The Lightning Kid'. He won world titles in three different formats — classical, rapid, and blitz — and dominated chess from the 1990s into the 2010s. Anand inspired an entire generation of Indian chess players, including Praggnanandhaa and Gukesh, who now rank among the world's best.
fun_facts: He thinks so quickly he is nicknamed 'The Lightning Kid'
He inspired an entire generation of Indian chess grandmasters
He won the World Championship in three different formats of chess
players.style: Rapid calculation, universal opening repertoire, lightning decision-making, calm under pressure

players.name: Judit Polgár
players.biography: Judit Polgár is the greatest female chess player in history and one of the greatest players of any gender. The Hungarian prodigy became a grandmaster at just 15 years old — breaking Bobby Fischer's record as the youngest ever. She defeated nine World Chess Champions during her career, including Kasparov, Karpov, and Anand, playing in the men's tournament rather than women's events. Her fearless attacking style and tactical brilliance earned her a peak ranking of world number 8. She retired in 2014 to focus on promoting chess in schools, becoming chess's greatest ambassador.
achievements: Grandmaster at 15 — youngest ever at the time
fun_facts: She became a grandmaster at 15, breaking Bobby Fischer's record
She beat 9 different World Chess Champions
She chose to play in men's events rather than women's-only tournaments
players.style: Explosive attack, fearless tactics, brilliant combinations, aggressive opening play

players.name: Ma Long
players.biography: Ma Long is the greatest male table tennis player of all time, nicknamed 'The Dragon' and 'The Captain'. The Chinese superstar achieved the 'Career Grand Slam' — winning every major title possible — and is the only player to win back-to-back Olympic singles gold medals (2016, 2020). His all-round game is considered perfect: powerful forehand loop, superb backhand, and unmatched footwork. He has held the world number one ranking for an extraordinary length of time and competed professionally into his mid-30s at the highest level. Many coaches regard his technique as the gold standard for modern table tennis.
fun_facts: He is the only man to win back-to-back Olympic singles gold medals
Coaches study his technique as the perfect model for table tennis
He won his fifth World Championship title aged 31
players.style: All-round perfection, powerful forehand loop, exceptional footwork, unbreakable mental strength

players.name: Jan-Ove Waldner
players.biography: Jan-Ove Waldner of Sweden is known as 'The Mozart of Table Tennis' for his genius and creativity. At a time when Chinese players dominated the sport, the Swede broke through to win the Olympic gold at Barcelona 1992 and the World Championship twice. His anticipation, deceptive serve, and ability to read opponents were decades ahead of his time. He competed professionally for over 35 years, reaching age 40 still ranked in the world's top 10. In China he is revered as a sporting god — an extraordinary tribute to a European player in a sport dominated by Asian nations.
fun_facts: He is nicknamed 'Lao Wa' (Old Waldner) and worshipped in China
He competed professionally into his late 40s
He is the only European to win the Olympic singles title in the modern era
players.style: Genius anticipation, deceptive serves, magical creativity, timeless technical excellence

players.name: Deng Yaping
players.biography: Deng Yaping is the greatest female table tennis player in history. Despite being told she was too short at 1.5m to ever reach the elite level, she became the most dominant champion the sport has ever seen. She won four Olympic gold medals (1992, 1996 — singles and doubles) and was world number one for eight consecutive years. Her aggressive forehand and lightning reflexes made her almost impossible to beat. At the 1992 Barcelona Olympics she won two golds in one week. She retired in 1997 unbeaten at the top level, went on to earn a PhD from Cambridge University, and became an inspirational figure worldwide.
fun_facts: She was told she was too short to become elite — then won 4 Olympic golds
She earned a PhD from Cambridge University after retiring
She was world number one for 8 straight years
players.style: Ferocious attack, ultra-fast reflexes, aggressive forehand, unstoppable at her peak

players.name: Fan Zhendong
players.biography: Fan Zhendong is the dominant force in contemporary table tennis and the heir apparent to Ma Long's throne. The Guangzhou-born star became the youngest ever world number one at 18 and has held the top position for much of his career. He won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 in team events and is a multiple World Champion. His explosive two-wing attack — powerful on both forehand and backhand — and his ability to produce brilliant shots under pressure mark him as a player of exceptional quality. Many experts believe he will break all existing records during the rest of his career.
fun_facts: He became the youngest world number one at just 18
He defeated Ma Long in major finals, showing the student can beat the master
He is considered the future of world table tennis
players.style: Two-wing power attack, explosive pace, clinical under pressure, complete modern game

players.name: Liu Shiwen
players.biography: Liu Shiwen is one of the finest female table tennis players of her generation, a complete player with outstanding technique on both wings. The Guangzhou native has won multiple World Championship titles, World Cup victories, and Olympic medals throughout her career. Known for her silky smooth forehand loop and steady backhand, she won the Grand Slam — all three major titles in one year — in 2019. Despite fierce competition from team-mates in what is arguably the strongest women's table tennis squad ever assembled, Liu Shiwen has consistently reached the very top of the sport.
fun_facts: She won the Grand Slam — World Championship, World Cup, and Olympics — in 2019
She has faced some of the toughest competition from within China's own squad
Her forehand loop is considered one of the most beautiful strokes in the game
players.style: Smooth forehand loop, balanced two-wing game, consistent excellence, clinical in key moments

players.name: Michael Jordan
players.biography: Michael Jordan is the greatest basketball player of all time — a combination of athletic genius, competitive fire, and will to win that the sport has never seen before or since. 'His Airness' won six NBA Championships with the Chicago Bulls and was Finals MVP every single time. He was a 14-time All-Star, five-time MVP, and three-time Slam Dunk champion. His iconic partnership with Scottie Pippen produced two three-peats (1991–93, 1996–98). His story — cut from his high-school team — is the most inspiring comeback tale in sport. He famously 'came back from retirement' to win three more titles. The documentary The Last Dance captivated a new generation.
fun_facts: He was cut from his high school varsity basketball team
He scored 63 points against Boston Celtics in a single playoff game
His Nike Air Jordan deal (1984) revolutionised sports marketing forever
players.style: Explosive athleticism, killer instinct, unstoppable mid-range jumper, elite defence, iconic determination

players.name: LeBron James
players.biography: LeBron James is basketball's greatest all-around player — a physical specimen with the size of a power forward, the speed of a point guard, and the vision of a playmaker. Nicknamed 'The King' and 'The Chosen One', he entered the NBA at 18 directly from high school and never stopped exceeding expectations. He has won four NBA Championships with three different franchises — an almost unparalleled achievement. The most impressive stat: he leads the NBA in all-time scoring (38,000+ points) AND is one of the all-time assists leaders. He famously delivered Cleveland's first major sports championship in 52 years in 2016, erasing a 3–1 series deficit against Golden State.
fun_facts: He is the only player to lead the NBA in points, rebounds, and assists in the same season
He scored 38,000+ career points — the most ever in NBA history
His son Bronny became the first father-son duo to play in the NBA at the same time
players.style: Total basketball genius, unstoppable athleticism, elite playmaking, extraordinary longevity

players.name: Kobe Bryant
players.biography: Kobe Bryant was the Black Mamba — as ruthless, precise, and relentless as the snake he modelled himself on. The 18-time All-Star entered the NBA at 17 straight from high school and spent 20 seasons entirely with the Los Angeles Lakers, winning five championships. His work ethic was legendary: he reportedly arrived at practice at 4am and was the last to leave. In his final NBA game in 2016, aged 37 with a broken-down body, he scored 60 points — one of sport's most extraordinary farewell performances. His tragic death in a helicopter crash in 2020 shocked the world. He left behind a legacy of Mamba Mentality — the idea of relentless pursuit of excellence.
achievements: 81 points in one game (2nd highest ever)
fun_facts: He scored 81 points in a single game — the second highest ever
He spoke four languages — English, Italian, Spanish, and French
His final NBA game saw him score 60 points aged 37
players.style: Ice-cold mid-range, relentless work ethic, killer mentality, unstoppable post moves, Mamba Mentality

players.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
players.biography: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar held the NBA all-time scoring record for nearly four decades and is arguably the most dominant big man the sport has ever produced. His signature shot — the skyhook — was virtually unstoppable and he used it from college through to his final NBA season at age 42. Born Ferdinand Lewis Alcindor, he converted to Islam in 1971 and changed his name. He won six NBA Championships and six Most Valuable Player awards — both are records or near-records. Standing 7 feet 2 inches tall with extraordinary agility, footwork, and basketball intelligence, he revolutionised the centre position.
achievements: NBA all-time scorer until LeBron (38,387 points)
fun_facts: His skyhook shot was called 'the most unstoppable move in basketball history'
He held the NBA all-time scoring record for 38 years
He was a black belt in martial arts and trained with Bruce Lee
players.style: Unstoppable skyhook, imposing physical presence, basketball genius, extraordinary longevity

players.name: Maya Moore
players.biography: Maya Moore is the greatest women's basketball player of the 21st century and one of the most accomplished athletes in any sport. The Connecticut Huskies star won back-to-back NCAA Championships before entering the WNBA, where she became a four-time champion with the Minnesota Lynx. She was Finals MVP, Regular Season MVP, and WNBA champion in the same year (2013). But perhaps her most remarkable achievement came off the court: in 2019 she paused her career to help free Jonathan Irons, an innocent man imprisoned for 22 years. She succeeded — and married him. Her moral courage matched her extraordinary basketball talent.
fun_facts: She stepped away from basketball at the peak of her career to fight for justice
She helped free an innocent man after 22 years in prison
She married the man she helped free, Jonathan Irons
players.style: Elite scorer, powerful defender, clutch performer, outstanding basketball IQ, natural leader

players.name: Simone Biles
players.biography: Simone Biles is the greatest gymnast in history — male or female. She has won more World Championship medals (30) than any gymnast ever. Her four signature moves (named 'The Biles') are so difficult no other gymnast has attempted them in competition. She dominated the 2016 Rio Olympics, winning four golds and a bronze. Her story of overcoming childhood adversity, being in foster care, and her courage in speaking about mental health at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics — where she withdrew to protect herself — has made her one of the most important athletes alive. She returned triumphantly at Paris 2024, winning three more gold medals.
fun_facts: She has four gymnastic moves named after her — The Biles I, II, III, and IV
She has won more World Championship medals than any gymnast in history
She trained with a full-time FBI investigator after reporting Larry Nassar's abuse
players.style: Superhuman power and speed, extraordinary air awareness, difficulty unlike any other, flawless execution

players.name: Nadia Comaneci
players.biography: Nadia Comaneci changed gymnastics forever at the age of 14. At the 1976 Montreal Olympics she scored the first-ever perfect 10.0 in Olympic gymnastics — a moment so stunning the scoreboard could not even display it (it showed 1.00 because a 10.0 was considered impossible). She went on to score seven perfect 10s that week, winning three gold medals. Her flawless technique, unbelievable body awareness, and calm perfection under pressure made the world fall in love with gymnastics. She went on to win five Olympic golds across two Games and inspired millions of girls to take up the sport worldwide.
fun_facts: The scoreboard at Montreal couldn't show 10.00 — it displayed 1.00 instead
She was only 14 years old when she scored the first perfect 10
She inspired so many girls to take up gymnastics it became a global phenomenon
players.style: Flawless precision, perfect lines, extraordinary balance, ice-cool composure at 14 years old

players.name: Larissa Latynina
players.biography: Larissa Latynina held the record for the most Olympic medals of any athlete in history for 48 years. The Soviet gymnastics queen won an astonishing 18 Olympic medals — nine gold, five silver, and four bronze — across the 1956, 1960, and 1964 Olympic Games. She was the world's dominant gymnast for a decade, combining grace, artistry, and technical precision in a way that redefined her sport. Her nine Olympic golds remained a record until swimmer Michael Phelps surpassed her total in 2012. She is the greatest Olympic medallist in gymnastics history and among the greatest Olympians of all time.
achievements: 18 Olympic medals (9 gold, 5 silver, 4 bronze) — held record for 48 years
fun_facts: She held the record for most Olympic medals for 48 years
She won medals at three consecutive Olympic Games
Michael Phelps needed 22 Olympic medals to finally beat her record
players.style: Exquisite artistry, graceful lines, technical mastery, extraordinary competitive longevity

players.name: Kohei Uchimura
players.biography: Kohei Uchimura is widely recognised as the greatest male gymnast in history. The Japanese star won seven consecutive World All-Around Championships (2009–2015) and back-to-back Olympic All-Around golds (2012, 2016). His ability to perform six different apparatus — floor, pommel horse, rings, vault, parallel bars, and high bar — all to world-class standard simultaneously is what separates him from everyone else. Known as 'The King' of gymnastics, he raised the difficulty and artistry of men's gymnastics by a full generation. He competed at the 2021 Tokyo Olympics as a symbol of Japanese national pride on home soil.
achievements: Most decorated gymnast in World Championship history
fun_facts: He won the World All-Around Championship seven times in a row
He is the only gymnast to win back-to-back Olympic all-around golds in the modern era
He sometimes plays Pokemon Go during warm-ups to relax
players.style: Perfect all-around excellence, highest difficulty scores, flawless landings, serene competitive composure

players.name: Alexei Nemov
players.biography: Alexei Nemov was the most charismatic and spectacular gymnast of his era — a Russian showman who made audiences gasp with his dazzling high bar routines. He won twelve Olympic medals across the 1996, 2000, and 2004 Games — making him one of the most decorated gymnasts in Olympic history. His signature high bar routine at the 2004 Athens Olympics was so breathtaking that the crowd booed the judges for awarding him scores they felt were too low — a remarkable scene in Olympic history. His athleticism, artistry, and charm won hearts around the world and made gymnastics a prime-time sport in Russia throughout his career.
achievements: Most beloved Russian gymnast of his era
fun_facts: Crowds at the 2004 Olympics booed the judges for giving him low scores
He won 12 Olympic medals — one of the highest totals in gymnastics
His high bar routines were considered masterpieces of the sport
players.style: Spectacular high bar, explosive power, dramatic flair, outstanding showmanship, crowd favourite

players.name: Muhammad Ali
players.biography: Muhammad Ali is the greatest athlete and the greatest boxer who ever lived. The Louisville-born prodigy won the Olympic gold in 1960, then became Heavyweight Champion of the World three times. His fights were events that stopped the world: 'The Rumble in the Jungle' against George Foreman in Zaire, 'The Thrilla in Manila' against Joe Frazier, his shock knockout of Sonny Liston. He was stripped of his title for refusing military service during Vietnam, saying 'No Viet Cong ever called me nigger' — an act of extraordinary courage. His speed, footwork, and the 'rope-a-dope' tactic redefined boxing. Beyond boxing, he was the world's most famous human being.
achievements: Sports Illustrated Sportsman of the 20th Century
fun_facts: He predicted the round he would knock out his opponents — and was often right
He was stripped of his title for refusing to serve in Vietnam — then had the decision overturned by the Supreme Court
'Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee' is the most famous phrase in sports history
players.style: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee — electrifying footwork, blazing jab, rope-a-dope, poetry in motion

players.name: Mike Tyson
players.biography: Mike Tyson was the most feared heavyweight in boxing history — a terrifying combination of speed, power, and ferocity that made opponents shake with fear before a single punch was thrown. 'Iron Mike' became the youngest-ever heavyweight world champion at just 20 years old in 1986 and won his first 37 professional fights, 26 by first-round knockout. His peek-a-boo style — developed with legendary trainer Cus D'Amato — combined elite defensive head movement with explosive counter-punching power. His story — from juvenile delinquent in Brooklyn to world champion, then from prison to comeback — is one of boxing's most dramatic tales.
achievements: Youngest Heavyweight World Champion (20 years old)
fun_facts: He became Heavyweight Champion at 20 — the youngest ever
He once said 'Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the mouth'
He had a pet tiger that he kept in his mansion
players.style: Peek-a-boo defence, explosive power, devastating hooks and uppercuts, speed belying his size

players.name: Joe Louis
players.biography: Joe Louis, 'The Brown Bomber', is one of the most significant athletes in American history. The Alabama-born heavyweight was World Heavyweight Champion for a record 11 years and 8 months (1937-1949) and defended his title 25 times — both records. In 1938, his knockout of German champion Max Schmeling — champion of Nazi Germany — became a global symbol: a Black American defeating a man the Nazis had presented as a symbol of white supremacy. Over 70 million people listened on the radio. Louis served in the US Army during World War Two and donated his purse money to the Navy and Army Relief Fund. He is an American hero.
achievements: Heavyweight World Champion for 11 years 8 months (record)
fun_facts: His knockout of Max Schmeling in 1938 was heard by 70 million people on the radio
He was champion for almost 12 years — the longest reign ever
He donated his prize money to US military charities during World War Two
players.style: Methodical power, devastating jab, clinical body shots, overwhelming technical excellence

players.name: Sugar Ray Leonard
players.biography: Sugar Ray Leonard was the most complete boxer of the 1980s — a gifted athlete who combined dazzling hand speed with exceptional intelligence and showmanship. He won world titles in five different weight classes and defeated four undisputed world champions: Duran, Hearns, Hagler, and Benitez. His 'No Más' match against Roberto Duran in 1980 — where he so frustrated Duran that the champion quit — is one of boxing's most dramatic moments. His 1987 split-decision victory over Marvin Hagler — coming out of retirement with one eye and minimal preparation — is considered one of boxing's greatest upsets.
achievements: Boxing Writers Association Fighter of the Year twice
Ring Magazine Fighter of the Year

He came out of retirement with one eye and beat the feared Marvin Hagler

players.style: Lightning hand speed, dazzling footwork, showboating, brilliant counterpunching, tactical intelligence

players.name: Claressa Shields
players.biography: Claressa Shields is the greatest female boxer in history and one of the most decorated combat sports athletes of any gender. The Flint, Michigan native won back-to-back Olympic gold medals at London 2012 and Rio 2016, becoming the first American boxer to achieve this feat. As a professional she became a three-division world champion — winning every belt available in three different weight classes. She did this in just 13 professional fights — the fastest any boxer has ever unified world titles. Known as 'GWOAT' (Greatest Woman Of All Time), she has also competed in MMA and is a fearless, outspoken champion for women's boxing.

First American boxer with consecutive Olympic golds
Ring Magazine Fighter of the Year 2018

players.name: Michael Schumacher
players.biography: Michael Schumacher is the most successful Formula 1 driver in history. The German maestro won a record seven World Drivers' Championships — five consecutively with Ferrari (2000-2004) — and 91 race victories, scoring more poles and fastest laps than any driver before him. He transformed Ferrari from a team in crisis into the most dominant force in F1 history. His technical feedback to engineers, his physical conditioning, and his commitment to improvement made him the blueprint for the modern racing driver. After a tragic skiing accident in 2013 he has been in private care. He remains F1's most revered and admired champion.
fun_facts: He won 5 championships in a row with Ferrari — a record that may never be matched
He was so fast Ferrari sometimes let him win races from last — just for the spectacle
He came back to race in F1 from 2010-2012 at age 41
players.style: Ultra-precise car control, brilliant in wet conditions, extraordinary racing intelligence, unmatched commitment

players.name: Ayrton Senna
players.biography: Ayrton Senna is the most beloved racing driver in history. The Brazilian genius won three World Championships with McLaren and is universally regarded as the fastest driver ever in the wet. His performances in rain — Monaco 1984, Donington 1993 — border on the supernatural. His speed in qualifying was so extraordinary that team-mates could not understand how he found the laps. He had a deep spiritual faith and spoke emotionally about transcendent experiences while driving at the limit. His death at Imola in 1994 shocked the world and cast a long shadow over motor racing. Brazil celebrated three days of national mourning.
achievements: 65 pole positions (including a miraculous Monaco 1984 in the rain)
Senna — Oscar-winning documentary about his life

He donated much of his wealth to Brazilian charities for poor children
players.style: Other-worldly pace in the wet, supernatural qualifying laps, passionate intensity, absolute commitment

players.name: Lewis Hamilton
players.biography: Lewis Hamilton is the most decorated Formula 1 driver in history, sharing the record of seven World Championships with Michael Schumacher. The Stevenage-born British driver became the first Black Formula 1 champion in 2008 — a history-making moment. He has won 104 grand prix — more than any driver ever — and 104 pole positions. His ability across all circuit types and in all conditions, combined with his extraordinary race-craft and overtaking skill, set him apart. He is also an outspoken advocate for racial equality and the environment, using his enormous platform to fight for social change. He was knighted by King Charles in 2025.
achievements: 7x Formula 1 World Champion (joint record with Schumacher)
fun_facts: He won his first world title by one point, overtaking the Timo Glock on the final corner of the final lap in 2008
He is the only driver ever to score points in every single race of an entire season

players.style: Exceptional in the rain, supreme overtaking skill, brilliant tyre management, all-round complete driver

players.name: Max Verstappen
players.biography: Max Verstappen is the most dominant Formula 1 driver of the current era. The Dutch-Belgian son of former F1 driver Jos Verstappen burst into Formula 1 at just 17 — the youngest driver ever — and immediately showed fearless racecraft and extraordinary natural pace. He won his first World Championship in 2021 in the most dramatic final race in F1 history and followed it with back-to-back-to-back-to-back titles (2021-2024). His 2023 season — 19 wins from 22 races — is statistically the most dominant season in Formula 1 history. His aggressive overtaking, race craft, and ability to manage tyres mark him as a generational talent.
achievements: Most wins in a single season multiple times

players.name: Alain Prost
players.biography: Alain Prost, 'The Professor', won four Formula 1 World Championships with his calculating, methodical approach to racing. The French driver believed in finishing every race — he would calculate the exact pace needed to win without destroying his tyres or car, giving him the nick name 'The Professor'. His rivalry with Ayrton Senna — at McLaren in 1988 and 1989, and then at rival teams — was the greatest F1 rivalry in history, and their 1989 Japanese Grand Prix collision was F1's most controversial moment. He won 51 races and held the all-time wins record for a decade until Schumacher overtook him.
achievements: Commander of the Legion of Honour
